start.instruction: Light one exact carried regular log with the carried tinderbox. Continue only while the nearby line remains clear; no future logs or disposal are assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 1 required to light regular logs.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional ordinary position: the scoped action consumes one carried log.

consumes.description: One exact carried regular log for one lighting action.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the oak-log tier or selected goal boundary.
Recheck when carried regular logs are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One lighting action is modeled. Terrain, future log acquisition and a sustained line are not inferred.

methods.reason: A bounded early Firemaking action that uses only a verified tinderbox and carried log.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified low-level lighting action; no hourly rate or resupply.

sources.notes: The iron-account guide recommends burning regular logs to level 15 before oak logs.
Level 1, tinderbox use and the regular-log lighting action were reviewed.
Exact tinderbox and regular-log identities use pinned public gameval constants.

start.instruction: Light one exact carried oak log with the carried tinderbox. Continue only while the nearby line remains clear; no woodcutting, future logs or disposal are assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 15 required to light oak logs.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional ordinary position: the scoped action consumes one carried log.

consumes.description: One exact carried oak log for one lighting action.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Firemaking target.
Recheck when carried oak logs are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One lighting action is modeled. Terrain, Woodcutting and future log acquisition are not inferred.

methods.reason: A UIM-relevant path toward 50 that frees the verified carried log position one action at a time.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified oak-log lighting action; no Woodcutting, hourly rate or resupply is credited.

sources.notes: The iron-account guide recommends oak logs through most of the route to 50 and does not require bank access.
Level 15, tinderbox use and the oak-log lighting action were reviewed.
Exact tinderbox and oak-log identities use pinned public gameval constants.
